summary: Haoxin Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of two independent directors (Bangjie Hu and Mikael Charette) effective July 8, 2026, and the appointment of Ro Phansalkar and Mengzhi Wang as replacements on July 20, 2026. It also disclosed a Nasdaq extension until December 14, 2026 to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement due to non-compliance since October 30, 2025. No specific terms, price, premium, or deal structure are mentioned. This is a routine corporate governance update and compliance disclosure, not a special-situation event.
